units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:53">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>מה עיבוד … שהיו מְשַׁרְטְטִין בעורות</he> what working in leather was done at the preparation of the Tabernacle? They traced the outlines on the skins (marked out the shape in which they were to be cut, v. <cite ref="U01072"><he>שִׁירְטוּט</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:53">Ib.</cite> top [read:] <he>מה צביעה … שהיו משרטטין בעורות</he> what painting was done at the preparation of the Tabernacle? They marked the skins (with a coloring substance); [the following <he>אלים מאדמים</he> ought to be preceded by <he>עורות</he>, as the catchword to the subsequent discussion, v.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 8:23">Tosef. ib. VIII, 23</cite>].—Part. pass. <he>מְשׁוּרְטָט</he>; f. <he>מְשׁוּרְטֶטֶת</he>.
<cite ref="Menachot 32b:3">Men. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>מזוזה שאינה מש׳</he> a door post inscription which is not written on ruled parchment.
